items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: But he put Arnold Friskin with us, the bass player.

ctx.x: No, well see Chubby is a different type of player. He did that kind of playing. Lennie was, I don’t know if you want to say sophisticated or what. But we played a couple of jobs together but really Arnold Fishkin, Chubby was supposed to come in — I thought Chubby would be with Lennie and myself and Chubby. Because Chubby operated this see. But he put Arnold Friskin with us, the bass player. But a couple of dates Chubby was angling around. One of them was on 52nd Street. And I was playing like I was playing with…
